description: No API key. US drug facts from openFDA as clean JSON in one call: FDA label sections (indications, boxed warning, contraindications, drug interactions, dosage), NDC products and packages, FDA approvals, top reported adverse events (FAERS counts) and recalls. Interaction mode finds where one drug's FDA label names another. Monitor mode returns only new recalls or label versions. Free: 5 calls/day per IP. Paid: Radar API key (from €15/mo at https://radarbg.com/pricing#starter via X-API-Key) or $0.02/call via x402 at https://radarbg.com/x402/fda-drug-lookup-api.

drug.description: Brand or generic name, e.g. metformin, Lipitor, Ozempic, atorvastatin. For several drugs use Drugs instead. Not needed when you give an NDC.

drugs.description: 1-10 brand or generic names. In report, label, ndc, approvals, adverse_events and recalls mode every drug gets its own rows (a watch list in one run). In interactions mode give 2-10 names: every pair is checked in both labels.

limit.description: How many rows for label, ndc, recalls and adverse_events modes (1-100). Report mode always returns one row.

mode.description: report = one row with label summary, NDC count, approvals, top 10 adverse events and latest recalls; label = full label sections; ndc = products with packages; approvals = Drugs@FDA applications; adverse_events = most reported reactions wit

ndc.description: Optional. Dashed product NDC like 0002-1433 or package NDC like 0002-1433-80. Wins over Drug name in report, label and ndc modes.

name: fda_drug_lookup_api
title: FDA Drug Label API - NDC, Interactions, Recalls
